description: Elections Commission - Appoint the assistant Returning officers for the gall Adminis Frative District (Election Members to the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: This gazette notice is an appointment of Assistant Returning Officers for the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha election, issued by the Election Commission under Section 27(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral processes and the appointment of election officials, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral commission appointments and decisions.
